# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release is supported with security updates.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Email: [dogiakos@gmail.com](mailto:dogiakos@gmail.com)

Include:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fix (optional)

You will receive a response within 72 hours. If the issue is confirmed, a fix will be prioritized. You will be credited in the release notes unless you prefer otherwise.
